asked: # urgent: recorder mic on/off per recording Brett, Nov 5 2026 (voice): "I want to be able to turn on the microphone or not too." ... "Create a new build called urgent and put that in it." This is axHub PR #30 (`claude/recorder-mic`): `amberx.recorder_start` gets an opt-in `mic` arg and the approval title says "Playback + MIC" when the mic will be on. It's 1 commit, behind main. ## Do - Merge main into the branch, fix conflicts, make the tests pass, push. Keep PR #30 as the PR (update its description). Do not merge it yourself; it goes through the normal merge flow. - Check the AmberX app side (MossesX/AmberX-AXF, the Audio Output Recorder on Android): it must honour the mic flag per recording. If it needs changes, write them in a separate AmberX-AXF branch `claude/urgent-recorder-mic` with a PR, Kotlin/Java noted as needing a new APK (no JDK on the VPS; CI compiles). - Console / Molly: wherever the recorder is started (voice command, MCP, any button), add a Mic on/off choice, default off. - Tests for the mic arg and approval title. Done: PRs updated/opened, report, THREADS row, readme, hand to the merge flow (don't merge). No sub-agents, Opus only, never print secrets. Short plain report at the end. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once. Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.
